event.resume: Watching was on when the app was last closed — resuming
event.watchWrite: Watching started: writing to files, checking every {{seconds}} s
event.watchDry: Watching started: trial mode, checking every {{seconds}} s
event.stopping: Stopping: waiting for the current run to finish
event.fileGone: {{file}} is unavailable: the file is missing or the network is down
event.busy: Already running: {{what}}. Wait until it finishes.
event.missingFiles: Files not found: {{files}}. Set the paths on the Storage tab.
event.smbFailed: Could not connect the network share: {{error}}

skip.projectNotConfigured: project “{{project}}” is not set up (Links tab)
skip.badId: odd ID “{{id}}” in the ID column
skip.foreignId: ID {{id}} belongs to an element of another Consum (“{{source}}”) — a copied row? Clear the ID in this row. If this is a new month, remove the old Consum from the list on the Storage tab
skip.blockNotFound: block with ID {{id}} not found in Sarjele
skip.blockTaken: block {{id}} is already linked to another row
skip.ambiguous: several matching blocks: {{blocks}} — choose one on the Links tab
skip.sharedBlock: block “{{title}}” is shared by several rows — link it by hand on the Links tab
skip.migrateNoBlock: block not found (migration does not create new blocks)
skip.noRoom: no room under the block for {{n}} new rows (consumption split over heats) — free the cells under the block on sheet “{{sheet}}”
skip.linkNotFound: links.json points to block “{{title}}”, but sheet “{{sheet}}” has no such block without an ID — check the title

warn.idCellBusy: {{element}}: something is already written next to the block title (“{{value}}”), the ID was not placed
warn.noRoomRows: {{element}}: no room for extra rows — the block was not changed
warn.noRoomRow: {{element}}: no room for an extra row ({{heat}})
warn.noRoomBlock: {{element}}: no room for a new block
warn.consumIdsSkipped: Consum: IDs not written to rows {{rows}} (cell taken or row not found)
warn.manualReopen: heat {{heat}} is marked yellow but steel was taken back — check whether it is needed again
warn.deferredOpen: Write postponed: “{{file}}” is open — it will retry by itself once closed
warn.linksBadKey: links.json: entry “{{key}}” skipped — the key must be “PROJECT|element”
warn.linksBadValue: links.json: entry “{{key}}” skipped — the value must be text: a block title, @new or @skip
warn.linksDuplicate: links.json: “{{key}}” appears twice — the last entry applies

note.consumIdsDeferred: Consum is open — {{n}} IDs will be written on the next run
note.consumNotUpdated: Could not update Consum ({{reason}}) — the IDs will be written on the next run
note.consumChanged: Consum changed while being processed — the IDs will be written on the next run

lock.busyHere: file “{{file}}” is being written by another run (this computer, since {{time}})
lock.busyHost: file “{{file}}” is being written by another run ({{host}}, since {{time}})
lock.busyUnknown: file “{{file}}” is being written by another run (another computer or an older version)
lock.staleDead: removed abandoned lock {{lock}} (the run that took it has ended)
lock.staleGone: removed abandoned lock {{lock}} (the lock folder disappeared)

sheet.badName: sheet name “{{name}}” is not allowed in Excel (allowed: “{{safe}}”)
sheet.noSample: no sample layout found (Sarjele has no blocks at all)

verify.kg: heat {{heat}}: {{got}} kg in Sarjele, {{want}} kg calculated
verify.idMissing: ID {{id}} not found at a block in Sarjele
verify.idUnregistered: ID {{id}} is missing from the Sarjele registry
verify.notPainted: heat {{heat}} is not marked yellow in Probe
verify.notUnpainted: yellow was not removed from heat {{heat}} in Probe

error.usage: The Consum, Sarjele and Probe files are not set
error.linksBroken: links.json cannot be read: {{error}}. Fix the file (Advanced → Manual links) or delete it — runs are stopped while it is broken
error.linksNotObject: links.json must be an object { "PROJECT|element": "block title" } — runs are stopped until the file is fixed

check.okOpen: Found · sheets: {{n}} · changed {{date}} · open in an editor
check.noYearSheet: No {{year}} sheet — choose the sheet by hand

smb.noHost: Enter the server and the shared folder
smb.unsupported: Connect the network share with system tools and choose the files on it

tech.overview: Probe: {{heats}} heats ({{closed}} closed); Sarjele: {{blocks}} blocks; Consum: {{rows}} rows with consumption
tech.idColumn: Consum: ID column — {{col}}, styled like {{donor}}, header rows {{top}}–{{bottom}}{{below}}
tech.unmapped: Consum projects that are not set up (their rows are skipped): {{projects}} — add them on the Links tab
tech.newSheets: Sheets to be created in Sarjele: {{sheets}}

idAction.adopt: the element moves to this Consum
idAction.backfill: the ID will be written to Consum

tech.oldHeatsTitle: Old open heats skipped as “abandoned” (check whether it is time to fill them yellow):
tech.reopen: Clear yellow in Probe (filled by the app, balance > 0 again): {{heats}}
tech.shortageTitle: !!! Not enough steel in Probe (these rows are not written to Sarjele):
tech.shortageLine: {{key}}: {{kg}} kg more needed ({{elements}}); free in open heats {{free}} kg{{closed}}
tech.shortageClosed: , another {{kg}} kg is listed in heats filled yellow
tech.shortageHint: What to do: add the delivery (heats) to Probe or clear yellow from a heat that still has steel.
tech.dryRun: (trial run: nothing written; add --apply to write)
tech.dryRunCreate: (trial run: nothing written; add --apply to create)
tech.verifyOk: ✔ Check after writing: the files match the calculation
tech.sheetsPresent: All project sheets already exist in Sarjele.
tech.restored: ✔ State {{stamp}} restored. The state before the restore is saved as {{savedAs}}.

drive.badFolder: The Google Drive folder is not recognised: {{folder}} — paste a folder link or its ID
drive.notXlsx: {{file}} in Google Drive is not an .xlsx table (a Google Sheets document will not do)
drive.busy: {{file}} is being written by another device ({{owner}}) — the run will be retried
drive.verifyFailed: {{file}}: what was uploaded to Google Drive does not match what was written
drive.notConfigured: Google Drive is not set up: put the OAuth client file {{file}} into the app data folder
drive.authRequired: Access to Google Drive was revoked or has expired — sign in to Google again on the Storage tab
drive.accessDenied: No access to the tables in Google Drive: {{error}}
drive.signedOut: Not signed in to Google — sign in on the Storage tab
drive.pageDone: Signed in. Go back to Somasync — you can close this window.
drive.pageFailed: Sign-in failed. Go back to Somasync and try again.
drive.notFound: Tables missing in the Google Drive folder: {{files}}
drive.conflict: {{file}} was changed in Google Drive during the run — the result was not uploaded, the next run will recalculate
